verified_facts.text: The resort sits between the Sierra Madre Occidental and the Pacific Ocean in Riviera Nayarit.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled between the Sierra Madre Occidental and the Pacific Ocean, Siari Riviera Nayarit, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve, is an intimate sanctuary in the untouched landscapes of Riviera Nayarit.

verified_facts.text: The resort is inspired by the traditions of the Wixárika (Huichol) people.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by the traditions of the Wixárika (Huichol) people, the Reserve celebrates Mexico's rich heritage through thoughtful design, regional cuisine and immersive wellness.

verified_facts.text: Puerto Vallarta airport is approximately 70.2 km from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: PVR is located approximately 70.2 KM from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Zula is led by chef David Castro Hussong and serves contemporary Mexican fine dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: Led by acclaimed Chef David Castro Hussong, Zula celebrates the flavors of Riviera Nayarit through contemporary Mexican fine dining

verified_facts.text: Naao serves contemporary Asian cuisine, Pacific seafood and open-fire cooking.
verified_facts.excerpt: Naao brings together the flavors of Nayarit and Asia through contemporary Asian cuisine, Pacific seafood, local ingredients and open-fire cooking

verified_facts.text: Maribel's is a coffee house led by pastry chef Maribel Aldaco.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pastry chef Maribel Aldaco layers local, American, German, and French traditions to craft sweet and savory delicacies.

verified_facts.text: Hotel guests have access to Nauka Golf Club by Tom Fazio.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, hotel guests have access to Nauka Golf Club by Tom Fazio.

verified_facts.text: Nauka Golf Club is a private club with a Tom Fazio-designed 18-hole course that has three oceanfront holes.
verified_facts.excerpt: This private club features a Tom Fazio-designed 18-hole championship course with three breathtaking oceanfront holes.

verified_facts.text: The Há Yeka spa offers treatments inspired by Wixárika traditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Há Yeka Spa & Wellness Center offers curated treatments inspired by Wixárika traditions

verified_facts.text: Suite design draws on Huichol colors, mountain stone and wood screens that evoke the jungle canopy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Soft tones recall the Huichol’s sacred desert pilgrimage, while stone details evoke the strength of the mountains, and wood screens filter light like the jungle canopy.

verified_facts.text: Select suites have private plunge pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private plunge pools in select hotel suites in Riviera Nayarit.

verified_facts.text: A gourmet breakfast at Estero restaurant is included with the stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: With our compliments, enjoy a gourmet breakfast at Estero restaurant, a wellness ritual kit, locally crafted art, and your choice of cultural immersion or guided meditation

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an outdoor adult pool and an outdoor family pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, Siari Riviera Nayarit, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve has multiple pools on-site for hotel guests:

verified_facts.text: Guests can follow trails to waterfalls, snorkel in conservation waters and enjoy cultural dance and song.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests may follow hidden trails to waterfalls, snorkel in conservation waters, discover the flavors of Nayarit cuisine, or embrace cultural traditions told through dance and song.

verified_facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service from the airports.
verified_facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers tennis and pickleball.
verified_facts.excerpt: From sunrise rallies to afternoon pickleball matches, enjoy an elevated racquet experience immersed in the tropical beauty of Riviera Nayarit.
